subject: Re: Expansion — surge credits, workstream tags & per-token tiering
messages:
From: Jacob Nyland <jacob.nyland@omnihealth.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@omnihealth.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Scaling additional teams — pricing and protect vs overage

Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our product org is ready to start sending a second wave of traffic (two new product teams). Before we commit, procurement asked for a clear view on: 1) how incremental commits map to per-token discounts, 2) an option for a small "surge credit" buffer for bursty launches, and 3) whether we can tag traffic by workstream so we only apply discounts to the scoped workloads.

Attached is the usage map (OMNI-MAP_v3.xlsx) showing expected monthly tokens by service and team. High level ask: can Redwood provide guidance for an incremental-commit path (e.g., commit X -> discount band Y) and an onboarding sleeve for the first 90 days to protect us from initial overages?

Best,
Jacob
Head of Product, OmniHealth

--
Jacob Nyland
OmniHealth

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Nyland <jacob.nyland@omnihealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Scaling additional teams — pricing and protect vs overage

Jacob —

Really useful worksheet, thanks. Quick answers up front: yes on workstream tagging (we can apply per-route/label metering so discounts only apply to selected workloads), and yes on a short-term surge credit to smooth launches.

I'll outline a proposed path and attach a one‑page offer. High level proposal:
- 90‑day onboarding sleeve: a one-time 20% overage protection credit on incremental tokens above initial commit for each new team.
- Incremental commit ladder: incremental commits tier (monthly committed tokens) mapped to marginal per-token discounts (example below). We recommend a mix of slab and marginal bands for predictable unit economics.
- Workstream tags: we will set up tagging and per-route reporting so you can exclude experimental services from discount calculations.

Putting Jordan and Marcus on this thread for pricing confirmation and implementation timing. I can get a draft contract addendum out early next week.

Naomi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jacob Nyland <jacob.nyland@omnihealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:28:00Z
Subject: RE: Scaling additional teams — pricing and protect vs overage

Jacob / team —

Thanks for the map. A concrete example to make the commit ladder tangible: assume the current commit is 100M tokens/month. For the two additional teams we see an incremental request of ~60M tokens/month. Proposed incremental commitment structure:

Option A (slab-style):
- 0-100M tokens: base rate (no change)
- 100M-200M tokens: Tier 1 price (5% discount on tokens in this slab)
- 200M-500M tokens: Tier 2 price (12% discount)

Option B (marginal-style):
- Tokens beyond current commit priced at marginal tiers: first 50M at 7% discount, next 50M at 11% discount, >100M at 15%

Surge credit approach (launch protection):
- One-time surge bucket equal to 15% of incremental commit for first 90 days. Any usage in that bucket is covered by credits, not billed.
- After 90 days, normal metering applies; overages billed monthly or applied to a top-up committed bucket if you choose to convert.

We can model both on your attached MAP and show monthly spend projections. Monica can operate the tagging rollout with your infra team (workstream-tagging-spec.md).

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Jacob Nyland <jacob.nyland@omnihealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Scaling additional teams — pricing and protect vs overage

Jacob —

I've run the numbers against Omni's MAP. A practical commercial path that balances risk:
1) Initial incremental commit: 60M tokens/mo (90-day trial window) at a blended incremental discount of 9% (marginal approach yields more fairness across bursty traffic).
2) Surge bucket: 9M tokens (15% of 60M) as credit for 90 days.
3) If after 90 days the teams stabilize above the commit, we convert the actual avg to a monthly committed bucket and increase discounts: 60M->80M = +2% discount, 80M->120M = +3% additional.
4) Workstream tagging: technical uplift is small; tagging will be in SDK + route metadata. Monica: can you confirm a 2-week rollout once we have API keys?

Also: to expedite procurement, we'll provide a short legal addendum that captures the surge credit and conversion mechanics. I'll include example spend scenarios in the addendum.

Marcus Lin
Head of Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Nyland <jacob.nyland@omnihealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@omnihealth.ai
Date: 2026-11-28T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion — surge credits, workstream tags & per-token tiering

Jacob —

Appreciate the quick sync here. Attached is the outline offer (redwood-expansion-offer-2026-11.pdf) and the tagging spec. Next steps we propose:
- Redwood to issue a commercial addendum (3 business days) reflecting: 60M incremental commit, 90-day 15% surge credit (9M tokens), marginal discount ladder starting at 7% for first band.
- OmniHealth to sign the addendum and provide the list of routes to tag for discounted metering.
- Monica to kick off tagging implementation: estimated 10 working days from signed addendum.

If procurement needs a one-line confirmation from legal on conversion mechanics, I can loop in our GC. Otherwise, happy to set up a short procurement Q&A on Friday.

Best,
Naomi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood-expansion-offer-2026-11.pdf (commercial outline), OMNI-MAP_v3.xlsx (usage), workstream-tagging-spec.md (implementation notes)
